gloss_en: After importing IFC from Revit/ArchiCAD back into Revit, objects show in plan but not in 3D.
question_paraphrase: 把REVIT、ARCHICAD、TEKLA匯出的IFC再匯入REVIT，平面看得到物件，3D卻找不到
context_given: REVIT, ARCHICAD, TEKLA 三套軟體
phrasing_notes: Blog first-person, English software names kept, short steps with screenshots
answer_summary: Set the 3D view phase to the latest phase created by import so the objects show.

gloss_en: HK Buildings Department: submitted BIM models are supplementary only; drawings prevail; plug-ins check GFA, sanitary, fire safety; Revit IFC export text file provided.
title_original: 建築信息模擬技術 - 屋宇署 BIM自動核查工具
question_paraphrase: 屋宇署：呈交的建築信息模型屬補充資料僅供參考，圖則與模型不一致以圖則為準；提供Revit/ArchiCAD外掛核查樓面面積、衞生設備、消防
phrasing_notes: Official register, HK terms 建築信息模擬, 認可人士
answer_summary: Models are reference only; BD tools (Revit/ArchiCAD plug-ins, openBIM building separation tool, BST) support checks; ADV-34/ADM-19 specify formats.

gloss_en: HK roadmap for adopting BIM in building plan preparation and submission; mandatory BIM submission tentatively 2029.
title_original: 採用BIM擬備和呈交建築圖則的路線圖
question_paraphrase: 政府2023年12月公布全面採用BIM擬備及審批建築圖則路線圖，暫定2029年強制呈交
answer_summary: Roadmap targets full BIM use; until then BD approves plans generated from BIM rather than the model itself.

gloss_en: BD 2nd-round stakeholder engagement on BIM roadmap (Chinese page redirects to English).
title_original: 採用建築信息模擬(BIM)擬備和呈交建築圖則的路線圖 - 第二輪持份者參與
question_paraphrase: 屋宇署第二輪持份者諮詢活動頁面（無繁中版本）
answer_summary: Consultation event; no IFC detail on page.

gloss_en: CIC workshop: exchange IFC between Archicad and Revit, evaluate geometry/data, clash detect.
title_original: CIC BIM進階工作坊：Open BIM協作 Archicad與Revit IFC交換個案
question_paraphrase: 工作坊：Archicad匯出IFC到Revit、Revit匯出IFC到Archicad，評估幾何與資料並做碰撞檢查
answer_summary: Hands-on IFC round trip between Archicad and Revit.

gloss_en: Graphisoft Taiwan help page explaining IFC in Traditional Chinese.
question_paraphrase: IFC是開放中立的資料交換格式，Archicad支援IFC2x3、IFC4、IFC4.3
phrasing_notes: Mainland-flavored terms: 導入/導出, 質量確保
answer_summary: IFC is an ISO open format by buildingSMART; Archicad imports/exports IFC2x3, IFC4, IFC4.3.

gloss_en: Taipei building administration manual: upload as-built (use permit) BIM model as IFC then trigger model conversion.
title_original: 使照竣工模型上繳操作手冊
question_paraphrase: 使照竣工模型上繳：在系統BIM模型頁選擇上傳IFC檔，上傳完成後啟動模型轉檔
answer_summary: Upload IFC on BIM model page then start conversion; as-built stage not permit review.
source_url: https://dbadgp.gov.taipei/DownFiles/Login/使照竣工模型上繳操作手冊.pdf

gloss_en: New Taipei Public Works BIM reference manual: Revit permit template, computer-aided review system, as-built delivery guidelines.
title_original: 新北市政府工務局BIM工作參考手冊108年版
question_paraphrase: 建造執照電腦輔助查核系統以Revit法規樣版為基礎，另含公有建築BIM竣工模型交付準則
answer_summary: Revit-based permit template and as-built delivery rules for public buildings.
source_url: https://www.bim.ntpc.gov.tw/Filedownload/新北市政府工務局BIM工作參考手冊108年版.pdf

gloss_en: Thesis: New Taipei permit rule-check system requires submitting IFC from Revit model with parameters defined by Taiwan building technical regulations.
title_original: 新北市建照電腦輔助查核與Revit模型IFC匯出研究
question_paraphrase: 新北市建照查核系統，團隊須將BIM模型IFC檔上傳，依建築技術規則定義元件參數
answer_summary: Model parameters must follow regulation definitions before IFC export for checking.

gloss_en: NTU thesis: IFC transfer from Revit to ETABS/SAP2000/Robot lost or changed data; native and API better.
title_original: BIM模型於結構分析軟體之資料傳遞研究（臺大碩士論文）
question_paraphrase: Revit傳到Robot/ETABS/SAP2000，IFC方式資料遺失或更動，原生檔與API較佳
answer_summary: IFC route poorest; native file and API transfers satisfactory.

gloss_en: NCU/NYCU theses: IFC import/export between BIM software still causes geometry distortion or loss.
title_original: IFC交換測試論文（中央大學/交大）
question_paraphrase: 無論IFC匯入或匯出到各BIM軟體，模型失真或遺失的情況仍會發生
answer_summary: Interoperability gaps persist; check settings before submission.

gloss_en: Revit 2022 IFC export fails with File is too large to export.
title_original: Error message with Revit 2022: File is too large to export
question_paraphrase: Many projects fail with 'File is too large to export', intermittent, persists after exporter update 22.5.1.0
answer_summary: Maintainer: message may be inaccurate; thin tubes, walls with reveals, complex railings bloat IFC; closed 2025 as not reproducible.

gloss_en: After exporter update accented/special characters encode as \X\E9 instead of \X2\00E9\X0.
title_original: New codification for special character and accent?
question_paraphrase: Encoding of special characters changed between Revit built-in exporter and newer exporter
answer_summary: Toolkit change (ODA) uses a compact representation; not an open-source exporter change. Relevant to CJK text in IFC.

gloss_en: Which Chinese encoding to use for IFC generation? UTF-8 still gives messy code.
question_paraphrase: Tried utf-8 but still messy code when generating IFC with Chinese
phrasing_notes: Short polite English from Chinese speaker
answer_summary: IFC/STEP has its own unicode encoding supported by IfcOpenShell; reported non-issue.

gloss_en: Strings in ifcXML truncated when they contain Chinese or Cyrillic characters.
title_original: Wrong string value parsed from the file
question_paraphrase: String truncated whenever it contains Chinese/Cyrillic characters
answer_summary: Open bug on ifcXML parsing of non-ASCII.

gloss_en: IfcConvert throws exception when element names contain Chinese characters.
question_paraphrase: IfcConvert to .dae fails with Chinese/Cyrillic characters in names
answer_summary: Later determined to be a docker mounting problem.

gloss_en: IfcExportAs parameter set to IfcSlab but slab edges still export as IfcBuildingElementProxy.
question_paraphrase: Set IfcExportAs to IfcSlab; still BuildingElementProxy
answer_summary: Parameter must apply to an element that can export as that class; test.

gloss_en: Revit 2026 won't export to IFC; possibly permissions or network drive.
question_paraphrase: Export fails; works to desktop but not mapped network drive
answer_summary: Likely Windows permission/write issue; save locally.

gloss_en: Check gross floor area per storey against the submission area table
prompt: 幫我檢查這個IFC每層樓的樓地板面積總和，跟送審圖面積表對不對得上
expected_behavior: Sum IfcSpace/IfcSlab areas by IfcBuildingStorey, compare to given table, list mismatches.

gloss_en: Count proxies and source categories
prompt: IFC裡面有幾個 IfcBuildingElementProxy？是Revit哪些類別匯出來的
expected_behavior: Count proxies, group by Revit category/Type properties, suggest IfcExportAs/mapping fixes.

gloss_en: Find what bloats the IFC
prompt: IFC檔太大 300MB 傳不上系統，幫我看是哪些東西最肥
expected_behavior: Rank products by geometry size/entity count (railings, MEP fittings), suggest exclusions or simplified export.

gloss_en: Check required parameters present
prompt: 查一下牆、門、窗有沒有填防火時效、材料欄位，缺的列出來
expected_behavior: Check Pset_*Common FireRating etc. on walls/doors/windows, report elements missing values.

gloss_en: Detect garbled Chinese names
prompt: 模型裡中文名稱有亂碼嗎？列出哪些元件名稱怪怪的
expected_behavior: Scan Name/Description/property strings for mojibake or unescaped characters, list GlobalIds.

gloss_en: Diff two submission versions
prompt: 這是第二次送審的IFC跟上一版比，哪些牆有改？GUID有沒有變
expected_behavior: Match by GlobalId, report added/removed/modified, flag GUID regeneration.

gloss_en: Check storey elevations and units
prompt: 樓層標高幫我列出來，B1到RF，單位是不是公尺
expected_behavior: List IfcBuildingStorey names and elevations, check unit assignment.

gloss_en: Concrete volume by storey and formwork area
prompt: RC柱梁板混凝土體積依樓層統計一下，另外模板面積
expected_behavior: Aggregate Qto volumes/areas of columns, beams, slabs by storey; note missing quantities.

gloss_en: MEP vs structure clash
prompt: 機電管線跟結構梁有沒有碰撞？大於50mm的列出來
expected_behavior: Run clash between IfcPipeSegment/Duct and IfcBeam, report with tolerance.

gloss_en: Check coordinates TWD97 and map conversion
prompt: 座標是不是TWD97？原點對不對，有沒有設IfcMapConversion
expected_behavior: Report IfcSite lat/long, IfcMapConversion/CRS, shared coordinates, flag missing.

gloss_en: Add classification codes from a table
prompt: 把所有門窗加上分類編碼欄位，照我給的對照表填
expected_behavior: Write classification references/properties from mapping table to doors/windows; save new IFC.

gloss_en: Stair riser/tread code check
prompt: 樓梯踏面跟級高有沒有符合建築技術規則？列出不合格的
expected_behavior: Read IfcStair/IfcStairFlight riser/tread properties, compare to thresholds, list violations.

gloss_en: Why doors become proxy on export
prompt: Revit匯IFC 門都變proxy 是哪裡設定錯了？
expected_behavior: Explain category mapping table, IfcExportAs, family category, check export settings.

gloss_en: Which IFC version for HK BD
prompt: 香港屋宇署BIM要用IFC2x3還是IFC4？Revit要選哪個MVD
expected_behavior: Explain checking BD ADV-34/ADM-19, typical Coordination View/Reference View, advise confirming with authority.

gloss_en: IFC visible in plan not 3D
prompt: IFC匯入Revit後平面有3D看不到，是不是階段的問題
expected_behavior: Explain phase filter/view phase, linking vs opening IFC.

gloss_en: Export room list for FM handover
prompt: 竣工模型要交FM，幫我匯出房間清單：編號、名稱、面積、樓層
expected_behavior: List IfcSpace with number, name, area, storey as table.

gloss_en: Column sizes by storey
prompt: 列出所有柱的斷面尺寸跟材料等級，依樓層
expected_behavior: List IfcColumn profile dimensions and material by storey.
